list_datasets_hub: list datasets on the Hugging Face Hub with optional search, sort, filter, and limit parameters
get_dataset_info: get detailed info about a specific dataset on the Hub including metadata and properties
run_sql_query_parquet: run a raw SQL query with DuckDB against dataset parquet file URLs
get_dataset_card: retrieve the dataset card (README) for a dataset with optional metadata or text-only output
list_leaderboard_scores: list model scores from a dataset leaderboard to compare models by benchmark results
